candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Misreads 遅くまで as 選くまで. Omits the vertical sidebar text (ユニット / 4 / ことばと文化). Loses bold emphasis on にとって/にとっての, and uses ①② instead of the filled ❶❷ for the exercise blanks. Dashed example box not represented.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Accurate throughout: 遅くまで correct, bold にとって preserved, filled ❶❷ used, sidebar ユニット/4/ことばと文化 included, CD icon noted, even the line break in example ② mirrored. Dashed box itself not drawn, but content faithful.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Text fully accurate (遅くまで correct), ❶❷ preserved, sidebar included, box suggested via horizontal rules. Loses bold emphasis on にとって/にとっての and drops the CD speaker-icon nuance; relative blank lengths reasonably shown.

rationale: B is best: fully accurate characters, retains the bold emphasis on にとって, the filled ❶❷ markers, the sidebar (ユニット 4 ことばと文化), and even the mid-sentence line break. C is nearly as complete and accurate (including the sidebar and correct 遅くまで) but drops the bold emphasis found in the source. A ranks last due to a clear character error (選く for 遅く), omission of the entire sidebar text, and loss of both the bold emphasis and the ❶❷ list markers.
